Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: first-person point-and-click castle exploration game background. Generate ONE full-bleed landscape 1536x1024 image, 3:2. Scene: the ground-floor SERVICE-WING CORRIDOR of the same inhabited medium-sized western fantasy lord's castle. The entrance from the main ground-floor gallery is BEHIND the camera, outside the frame. Fine realistic painted environmental concept art, pale warm-gray ashlar limestone and restrained pointed stone arches, dark oak ceiling beams and doors, simple aged bronze ironwork, maintained clean flagstone floor. Practical modest craftsmanship, calm dignified working household, no ruined or prison atmosphere. Soft daylight from a high leaded window and a few warm candles, rich natural restrained tones, room bright enough to read every doorway. Standing eye-level viewpoint down a comfortable broad SHORT corridor, approximately 3.4m ceiling, coherent rigid perspective, straight load-bearing architecture.
The image MUST show EXACTLY FOUR CLEARLY SEPARATE entrances, all on level floor, all complete from arch crown to threshold, suitable for distinct clickable silhouettes on a landscape mobile screen: (1) NEAR LEFT wall, around x=7%-26%, y=15%-92%, a plain CLOSED pointed dark-oak door to the maid bedroom, exposed and unblocked. (2) NEAR RIGHT wall, around x=77%-96%, y=14%-91%, a slightly more carefully finished CLOSED pointed dark-oak door to the butler bedroom, equally clear. (3) MIDDLE-DISTANCE RIGHT wall, before the far wall, around x=58%-70%, y=27%-81%, a second CLOSED simple oak door to the servants' common lounge, clearly separated from the nearer right door by a solid stone pier; large enough to click, not hidden behind the near door jamb. (4) CENTER-LEFT FAR WALL, around x=35%-52%, y=29%-79%, one OPEN broad pointed stone doorway to the kitchen, through which only a short warm-lit glimpse of a stone cooking hearth and an oak work surface can be seen; no people and no further doors inside. This far opening should be generous, not a distant pinhole. Keep these four doorway silhouettes visually distinct and avoid a very long corridor that makes the inner doors tiny. The source entrance behind the viewer is not drawn. Four visible doorways total, three closed room doors plus one open kitchen doorway. Furnish sparingly: one narrow peg rail with a neatly hung plain cloth on a free wall segment, a small built-in ledge, no freestanding furniture or objects blocking any doorway. No bed visible in corridor, no open bedroom view, no extra doors, no stairs or additional floor, no courtyard balcony. Do not paint labels or icons to distinguish the doors; frontend supplies destination text later. No people, modern objects, emblems, text, lettering, signs, UI, arrows, hotspot outlines, watermark, collage or exaggerated palace scale.
